name: Repair Hypergraph of a Six-Cycle Containment
definition: Write the six-cycle as the two-layer lift of $A=\{01,10,11\}$ and $B=\{00,01,10\}$ over outer coordinate $e$. For the failed containment $A\subseteq B$, the unique defect is $u=11$.
properties: The differences from the three possible mates in $B$ have supports $\{1,2\}$, $\{1\}$, and $\{2\}$, so the minimal repair hypergraph is $\mathcal H_O(e,1;11)=\{\{1\},\{2\}\}$. Contracting either layer coordinate repairs the containment. Fixing one to zero removes the defect; fixing it to one preserves that orientation's defect when the other coordinate remains, but the reverse outer containment then holds.
